text_visible: A very surprising result on MNIST
• Train the 784 to 800 to 800 to 10 net on a transfer set that does not contain any examples of 3. After this training, raise the bias of the 3 by the right amount.
• The distilled net then gets 98.6 percent of the test threes correct even though it never saw any threes during the transfer training.
An even more surprising result on MNIST
• Train the 784 to 800 to 800 to 10 net on a transfer set that only contains images of 7 and 8.
• After training, lower the biases of 7 and 8 by the optimal amount.
• The net then gets 87 percent correct over all classes.
details: The screen displays an X post detailing two counterintuitive machine learning experiments. text_visible: These were some magical results from distillation by @geoffreyhinton that reall...
这条X帖子由苹果ML研究员@zhaisf发布，分享了Geoffrey Hinton关于知识蒸馏的经典惊人实验，链接到dark14.pdf论文，强调蒸馏对训练分布具有极强鲁棒性。
实验一：在完全不含“3”样本的转移集上训练，调整3的偏置后，学生模型仍能达到98.6%的测试准确率识别“3”；实验二：仅用7和8图像训练，调整偏置后整体准确率达87%。
作者认为这些结果揭示了“暗知识”的魔力，为当下热门的on-policy与off-policy蒸馏提供了新解释，即两者尽管差异大但均有效。

text_visible: 这条X帖子由苹果ML研究员@zhaisf发布，分享了Geoffrey Hinton关于知识蒸馏的经典惊人实验，链接到dark14.pdf论文，强调蒸馏对训练分布具有极强鲁棒性。
实验一：在完全不含“3”样本的转移集上训练，调整3的偏置后，学生模型仍能达到98.6%的测试准确率识别“3”；实验二：仅用7和8图像训练，调整偏置后整体准确率达87%。
作者认为这些结果揭示了“暗知识”的魔力，为当下热门的on-policy与off-policy蒸馏提供了新解释，即两者尽管差异大但均有效。

text_visible: 这些是@geoffreyhinton通过蒸馏得到的一些神奇结果，当我第一次看到它们时真的震惊了我
TLDR：蒸馏在训练分布方面具有惊人的鲁棒性，即使它与目标分布的重叠很少甚至为零。
这也为现在热门的 on vs off policy 蒸馏话题提供了一个有趣的视角
A very surprising result on MNIST
Train the 784 -> 800 -> 800 -> 10 net on a transfer set that does not contain any examples of a 3. After this training, raise the bias of the 3 by the right amount.
The distilled net then gets 98.6% of the test threes correct even though it never saw any threes during the transfer training.
An even more surprising result on MNIST
Train the 784 -> 800 -> 800 -> 10 net on a transfer set that only contains images of 7 and 8. After training, lower the biases of 7 and 8 by the optimal amount.
The net then gets 67% correct over all classes.
